title: Official Docs Intake + Claim Extraction Adapter v1
summary: OpenAI/Anthropic/Google等の公式AI資料をboundedかつprovenance-preservingに発見・取得・固定化し、exact-anchor contract claim候補とcoverage auditを生成してHのtransition-evidence-bundle/v1へ接続する。取得・抽出結果は観測挙動や実行権限へ昇格しない。
original_problem: Hは旧版/新版のEvidence Bundleを比較できるが、公式docsの発見・取得・正規化・claim抽出が人手のまま残っている。新モデル公開のたびにURL探索と読み取りを手動で行うと追従が遅く、取得漏れ・非公式混入・抽出漏れ・redirect先の取り違えがHの入力品質を壊す。
why_it_matters: 公式docs intakeを機械化し、同じprovider-neutral契約でH→F→Gへ繋ぐことで、新AI世代への初動を短縮しつつ、無制限crawlerやLLM幻覚によるcontract捏造を避ける。
reason_frozen: 無制限crawl、非公式hostのOFFICIAL昇格、redirectでallowlist外へ逸脱、巨大文書/HTML/scriptの無制限取り込み、抽出できない文を黙って捨てる、keywordだけでhidden architectureを断定する、claim anchorを原文に存在しない形で生成する、取得時点でH/F/G実行権限を与える、という失敗をDAで禁止するまで実装しない。
preserved_value: provider-specific official-host registry with bounded discovery seeds
HTTPS-only fetch with redirect revalidation and byte/time/document caps
immutable raw source digest and exact final URL provenance
deterministic HTML/text normalization without script/style execution
extraction coverage audit with ambiguous/unmapped contract signals surfaced
docs claim remains hypothesis and never observed behavior
network failure preserves partial evidence and fails closed
trigger_conditions: RTS-FRZ-000018 Model Transition Intelligence v1 is COMPLETED
provider official documentation roots can be allowlisted
network fetch remains bounded and separate from runtime execution authority
negative_triggers: crawler can follow arbitrary internet links
redirected host is not revalidated against provider allowlist
unofficial host can be marked OFFICIAL by document content alone
claim anchor is synthesized instead of copied exactly from normalized source text
ambiguous contract-like text is silently ignored
network or extraction failure still emits READY bundle without audit warning
provider docs are treated as observed model behavior
intake output can mutate runtime routing or profiles
dependencies: RTS-FRZ-000018 Model Transition Intelligence + Architecture Contract Diff v1
